title: Expert Pollster on the ‘Deeper’ Dynamic That Could Bring Down Trump and MAGA
author: John Harwood
content:
There's less than a month to go before midterm Election Day, and things are
[looking good](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-elections/midterms) for
Democrats. But can we trust the polls? Can Democrats turn their momentum into
wins at the ballot box? And will Donald Trump's government let elections [play
out](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-dems-midterms-interfere-ice-polls-ballots)
[fairly](https://zeteo.com/p/how-to-stop-trump-from-interfering), or is the
U.S. becoming a "[shithole
country](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/trump-attacks-protections-
for-immigrants-from-shithole-countries-in-oval-office-
meeting/2018/01/11/bfc0725c-f711-11e7-91af-31ac729add94_story.html)" when it
comes to voting rights?

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Veteran Democratic pollster **Cornell Belcher** joins **Zeteo 's John Harwood
**to answer those questions and more - unpacking what's at stake these
midterms, why he thinks Democrats _could_ take back both the House and Senate,
and why the forces driving voters go far beyond gas prices.

**" There's something deeper about who we are as Americans that's being
violated," **Belcher says of the dynamic this election cycle.

This was a **live conversation** on [Zeteo.com](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)
and the Substack app, where subscribers could ask questions in real time. Be
